parties.petitioner: Hussainbhai Asgarali Lokhandwala, Asgarali Onali Lokhandwala, Husseni Mithiborewala

summary: Appeals arising from conviction in Sessions Case No. 292 of 2001 for offence under IPC. High Court altered conviction from Section 304 Part I to Part II IPC, sentenced appellant to five years RI. Challenge to alteration of conviction, sentencing, and upholding of acquittal in related case (Sessions Case No. 171 of 2004). Supreme Court upheld High Court's modification of conviction under Section 304 Part II IPC, confirmed sentence of five years RI for one appellant, imposed sentence already undergone for the other, and upheld dismissal of revision applications challenging acquittal of complainant's family members.
final_judgment: Appeals partly allowed and dismissed in accordance with the High Court's judgment; conviction under Section 304 Part II IPC upheld, sentences confirmed or set to period already undergone, acquittals in related case upheld.
